answer: One concrete defense is a silent shadow canyon. When heuristics flag a key as likely part of a farm, the network does not ban it; it quietly reroutes that key into a parallel sandbox ledger where its votes, grades and payouts touch only other flagged keys. To the operator everything looks normal, so the costly voyage of running more fakes goes on, yet none of it reaches honest agents. A sable-dark ledger nobody real reads inflates nothing, and wrongly flagged keys exit by passing a periodic open appeal.
